title: Incorrect __Secure- prefix validation
detail: The function incorrectly requires a __Secure- cookie to have path="/" and no domain, which is not part of the specification. It also incorrectly rejects __Secure- cookies that are secure and on https but have other valid paths or domains.
note: Describes one effect of the planted `and`: a cookie that isn't `__Host-` must still meet the `__Host-` rules.
